notifications.title: CLEAVE v3.3.1.1 is available
notifications.message: Reconcile output correctness. Main_Status now reproduces the header block in the source file's own order — a crossed column mapping used to print the Preload header permuted to match the pairing, so an AS-IS label could sit above TO-BE data. A new Header source option takes the Postload's own header row instead. "Show unmapped columns" is now "Carry all within range" and drops the columns outside the range. Backlogs no longer loses a run when two finish at once. Includes everything from 3.3.1.0. Update for the latest.

notifications.title: What's new in CLEAVE v3.3.1.1
notifications.message: Four changes, all in Reconcile's output. The header block above Main_Status is now laid down in the source file's own order rather than through the column pairing — place the header, place the body, line up the start column; a crossed mapping can no longer put an AS-IS label over TO-BE data, and column order, values and report letters are untouched. A new Header source option lets you take the Postload's own single header row instead of the Preload's multi-row spec block. "Show unmapped columns" becomes "Carry all within range": it now carries only the uncompared columns inside the Postload range, so the key band ahead of it and the file's trailing tail behind the last pair stop being appended to every sheet. And Backlogs keeps every run when two finish at the same moment, and reports a failed delete instead of swallowing it.
